scope: Localized mod category titles, tooltips and sorting in Chinese and English; metadata and unknown-namespace fallbacks.
Resource-pack Ponder name overrides and mod-provided name keys; original English names and registry namespaces remain searchable.
Language changes preserve the selected namespace and search query; scrolling, resize, item navigation and category layout use actual client screens and framebuffers.
Actual AE2S / Supergiant and Applied Pneumatics categories with their installed tutorial plugins; no Applied Pneumatics duplicate-scene diagnostics.
Core full editor, guide, media fallback and world-projection regressions; baseline physical dedicated servers with and without optional integrations.

related_applied_pneumatics.fix: All 26 air_network component aliases share one storyboard object; strict Ponder duplicate-ID validation is retained.

limitations: Linux llvmpipe rendering; not every GPU, shader or arbitrary modpack.
Revo UI 0.8.7, NFR 0.8.0 and ModularUI 3.2.0-nfr.2 are covered by the focused catalog scenario; unrelated external post-processing issues are outside this adapter.
This release does not repeat every historical optional-mod scenario. Historical results correspond to their original artifacts.
The supplied user log used Cleanroom 0.6.13-alpha; acceptance is on the required 0.4.0 final baseline, and does not certify that entire user modpack.
